कवार n. a lotus, L.

a: कवाट — See कपाट.

कवाटक ifc. = कवाट, Kathās.

क˚वीन्द्र-कर्णाभरण n. N. of wk.
कवीन्दु m. ‘moon of poets’, N. of Vālmīki, Śārṅg.

m: 1. कव a form substituted for क, का, and 1. कु, to express depreciation or deficiency, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 107, 108; Vop. vi, 97.

3. कव m. sound, L.

s: puM, klI, (kaM dehaM vaYcati vipakzAstrARi vaYcayitvA rakzati iti SezaH । ka + vanc + ac । kaM vAtaM vaYcati vA antarRyarTo vA । yadvA kavateiti kuDAtorac pratyaya iti kecit ityuRAdikozaH 42 । 2 .) sannAhaH । sA~joyA iti BAzA । (yaTA, vizRupurARe । 1 । 13 । 40 । “SarASca divyA naBasaH kavacaYca papAta ha” ॥) tatparyyAyaH । tanutram 2 varmma 3 daMSanam 4 uraSCadaH 5 kaNkawakaH 6 jagaraH 7 । ityamaraH । 2 । 8 । 64 ॥ daMsanam 8 jAgaraH 9 ajagaraH 10 । iti tawwIkA ॥ kawakaH 11 yogaH 12 sannAhaH 13 kaYcukaH 14 । iti jawADaraH ॥ * ॥ tasya yuktiryaTA । KaqgAdInAntu gaRanA pUrvvameva nidarSitA । astrAtmanEva nirddizwakavacAdirapIzyate ॥ tallakzaRaM saMgraheRa pravakzyAmi niboData । kAzWaM carmma ca sakalaM trayametattu dustaram ॥ yaTottaraM guRayutaM taTA pUrvvantu ninditam । SarIrAvarakatvantu laGutvaM dfQatA taTA ॥ durBedyateti kaTitaH kuvace guRasaMgrahaH । sacCidratAtigurutA tanutA suKaBedyatA ॥ kavacAnAM vinirddizwaH samAsAddozasaMgrahaH । atra varRo vinirddizwaH kramAdevaM caturvviDaH ॥ sito raktastaTA pItaH kfzRo brahmAdizu kramAt । kecit kurvvanti kuSalAH kavacaM DAtusamBavam ॥ kanakaM rajataM tAmraM lOhaM tezu yaTAkramam” ॥ iti yuktikalpataruH ॥ * ॥ “yaTA SastraprahArARAM kavacaM prati vAraRam । taTA dEvopaGAtAnAM SAntirBavati vAraRam” ॥ iti malamAsatattvam ॥ lOhAdivarmmavat aNgAdirakzaRArTaM devatAmantravigraham । tattu pUjAyAM pAWyaM BUrjje viliKya kaRWAdO DAryyaYca । iti tantram ॥ gardDaBARqavfkzaH । pawahavAdyam । iti medinI ॥

m: कवच m. n. (√ 3. कु, Uṇ. iv, 2; Nir. v, 25) g. अर्धर्चादि, armour, cuirass, a coat of mail, ŚBr. xii, 2, 2, 7; KātyŚr. xiii, 3, 10; MBh.; R. &c.
any covering
a corset, jacket, Kāṭh. xxxiv, 5 [ifc. f(आ). ], Pāṇ. iii, 2, 129
bark, rind, Śārṅg.
कवच m. a war-drum, a kettle-drum, L.
कवच n. a piece of bark or birch-leaf or any substance inscribed with mystical words and carried about as an amulet, any amulet, charm, W.
a mystical syllable (such as हुम्, or हूम्) forming part of a Mantra used as an amulet [cf. बीज], W.
कवच m. the tree Oldenlandia herbacea, Bhpr.
the tree Hibiscus Populneoides, L.
a: कवचः, --चं — [cf. Uṇ. 4. 2] 1 An armour, coat of mail, a mail. --2 An amulet, a charm, a mystical syllable (हुं-हूं) considered as a preservative like armour. --3 A kettledrum. --Comp. --पत्रः the birch tree. --हर a. {1} wearing armour. {2} old enough to wear an armour; कवचहरः कुमारः Sk.; cf. वर्महर in R. 8. 94. --(रः) a boy, child.

कवच-शिव m. N. of a Śaiva ascetic, Inscr.

m: कवच—हर mfn. wearing a coat of mail or jacket, W.

कवच—पाश m. the fastening of a coat of mail, AV. xi, 10, 22.

a species of birch, L. (cf. भूर्ज-पत्त्र.)

कवचिन् (ई), m. N. of Śiva
of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, MBh.

a mouthful, L.

a morsel, MBh.; R.; Ragh.; Mn.; Bhartṛ.
a wash for cleansing the mouth, gargle, Suśr.
a kind of fish (commonly Baliya), L.

water for rinsing the mouth, Bhpr.
a weight = कर्ष, ŚārṅgS.

putting into the mouth, Bālar.
